from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
import colorsys

im = Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB')
a = np.asarray(im).astype(float)
H, W, _ = a.shape
colmean = a.mean(axis=0)

# hue/sat/val per column
hsv = np.array([colorsys.rgb_to_hsv(r/255, g/255, b/255) for r, g, b in colmean])
hue = hsv[:,0]*360; sat = hsv[:,1]; val = hsv[:,2]

print("mean saturation:", sat.mean().round(3), " max:", sat.max().round(3))
print("mean value:", val.mean().round(3))

# hue histogram for saturated pixels (sat>0.25)
m = sat > 0.25
print("columns with sat>0.25:", int(m.sum()), "of", W)
import collections
bins = collections.Counter()
for h, s in zip(hue[m], sat[m]):
    bins[int(h//15)*15] += 1
for k in sorted(bins): print(f"hue {k:3d}-{k+15:3d}: {bins[k]}")

# how many columns are "blueish/greenish" (hue 90-270, sat>0.2)
bg = (sat > 0.2) & (hue > 80) & (hue < 280)
print("columns hue 80-280 (green/blue/purple):", int(bg.sum()))

# overall image mean color (all pixels)
print("image mean rgb:", a.mean(axis=(0,1)).round(1))
EOF
